ABSTRACT
Date of Publication:
07 July 2025
Key Terms:
Setting,
Realism,
Characterization, Character. Setting is defined as the time and place in which events, incidents, or actions occur in a given literary work. Settings can be real or imagined. The study that informed this article aimed to examine the depiction of setting in Mohamed S. Mohamed's novel *Kiu* and Ken Walibora's novel *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*. Although the research had three specific objectives, this article focuses on just one objective—to assess the contribution of setting to the construction of character traits in the novels *Kiu* and *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*. The assessment itself is grounded in a combination of two theories—Realism and Structuralism. The theory of Realism examines the authenticity of the social setting, while Structuralism emphasizes the function and interrelationship of artistic elements. This evaluative study was conducted in the library, employing an analytical design. The research area is written literature, specifically the genre of the Swahili novel. The target population of the study comprises 10 realist novels that depict authentic settings. A sample of two novels, *Kiu* and *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*, was selected through purposive sampling. These novels were selected based on the abundance of the aspects under investigation, namely the depiction of setting. In addition to reflecting the objectives of the study, the composition of the selected novels aligns with the framework of the combined theoretical approaches. The primary data for the study was collected through intensive reading of the texts of the selected novels. Secondary data was collected through intensive reading of books, theses, and various academic articles. The collected data was categorized according to the theoretical frameworks and objectives of the study. They were analyzed according to their content and the results presented descriptively. The findings of the study indicate that settings have a direct contribution to the development of characters' traits. These settings include: spatial settings (such as the banks of the Kiberenge River, the room of Chief Nasaba Bora, the forest, the cell, Mzee Mwinyi's room, and neighborhoods such as Vibyongoni, Selea, Ukele, and others) and temporal settings (the colonial era, five-year periods, the Second World War, and so on). These settings were skillfully crafted in a way that greatly facilitated the development of the characters' traits. The findings of this study are beneficial to novelists and literary critics in general. They will help them craft stories that portray and reflect authentic settings. INTRODUCTION  
A literary work is constructed using various artistic elements, including the use of setting. This element is important in literary writing and contributes to the construction and delivery of the author's message. Setting is often used by a writer to convey their message to the reader. The element of setting has been defined by various scholars. For example, Wamitila (2008) defines setting as an element that reveals to the reader where and when certain incidents or events took place. Settings can be realistic or imaginary. Realistic settings pertain to locations that exist in the real world. For instance, settings such as a forest, at the university, at home, in the office, in the city, and in places of worship. Imaginary settings refer to unusual environments and many are encountered through dreams. Examples of imaginary settings include paradise, the underworld, and hell. The setting depicted for the reader remains in their mind. Many writers, when crafting their works, place them in different settings to satisfy various literary and artistic purposes. It is therefore valid to state that setting is a fundamental pillar in artistic compositions. Setting influences the reader's perception in many ways, including providing a variety of images of what the author intended to convey (Wamitila, 2003; Matei, 2012; Massoud, 2022). These images can be, for example: visual imagery, which gives the reader the ability to 'see' what the author illustrates through words; movement imagery, which helps the reader experience an event 'in motion' according to the setting in which the event takes place; sensory imagery, where the reader experiences various feelings of the characters within the context as the author explores those emotions; gustatory imagery, which the reader perceives in settings where actions evoke a salivating response; and many others such as auditory imagery. Taking the example of the area of Selea, which appears in the novel *Kiu*, the author tells us that it was a place (setting) characterized by pervasive poverty and numerous hardships; the residents lived in shacks and some in rooms plastered with mud, and the road to get there was so bad that even Mwinyi’s car could not reach it. Characters such as Bahati and Chausiku’s mother, who lived in this neighborhood, were also poor. This means that the environment had a direct impact on these characters and their traits. They were poor, which is why they lived there. Wamitila (2002) explains that setting informs the reader about the character's journey from beginning to end in the story. Therefore, the reader comes to understand the character in every location and at every stage of their development. A good example is the character Mwalimu Majisfu in the novel *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*, about whom we are told of his childhood, his studies abroad, his involvement in alcoholism and failure to attend his classes at Nasaba Bora school, being dismissed from work and finding another job, becoming involved in theft of authors’ manuscripts, and failing to deliver lectures when invited to Wangwani. Here, we are given several traits of this character through various settings—that he was educated, an alcoholic, an academic thief, and negligent in his work. Character traits often help to identify and distinguish a particular character easily. These traits frequently reveal their habits, behavior, or even personality within the given literary work. In this regard, setting plays a significant role in depicting character traits (Wamitila, 2002). To a large extent, characters are influenced by the settings in which they are portrayed. Some literary works depict settings of poverty, numerous hardships, and characters living in shacks and mud-plastered rooms, as well as transportation that relies on poor roads. This means that the settings depicted by the artist have a direct impact on the construction of the traits of the characters in the given work. This is the issue that was investigated in the research that produced this article. The main objective was to examine the depiction of setting in the novels *Kiu* and *Kidagaa Kimemwozea* in order to establish the relationship between setting and character traits. Through assessment, the argument advanced by this article is that the settings in which characters find themselves in the novels *Kiu* and *Kidagaa Kimemwozea* contribute to the construction of their traits. It has been established that setting also influences the way certain characters are depicted. Setting plays a significant role in endowing characters with particular traits (Wamitila, 2002). To a certain extent, the place and time in which a character finds themselves signals and affects the depiction of their traits. Therefore, this article explores the relationship between setting and character traits in these two works and clearly reveals the existence of this relationship as well as how these authors have portrayed their characters.

THEORETICAL FOUNDATIONS  
Through the second pillar of the theory of Realism, this study examined how the authors of these selected books depicted reality in their works through the various settings they employed. This allowed us to identify some of the traits of different characters and thus helped us fulfill the objective of this study, which is to assess the contribution of setting in constructing character traits in the novels *Kiu* and *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*. The objectives of the study were guided by the combination of two theories, namely, the theory of Realism and the theory of Structuralism. The theory of Realism emerged in the nineteenth century (Ntarangwi, 2004). The term 'uhalisia' is a translation of the English word 'realism', which was originally used to refer to a branch of philosophy concerned with matters related to human perception. Currently, this term is used to refer to two meanings: the first is one that evaluates the state of life, that is, the reality in literature which signifies the skill of composition and describes events according to objectivity; and the second meaning is the actual condition of human life. The theory of Structuralism is often associated with the Prague linguists (Mwangi, 2005). It emphasizes the elements of an artistic work such as plot, message, characters, context, language, and how these interact to complete the work in question. This theory examines the relationships among the various components of literary compositions, such as structural narrative analysis. The theory focuses on the narration of an artistic work. For instance, structural analysis of a novel considers the novel as a self-contained work possessing structural elements such as plot, characters, and various narrative techniques that interrelate and depend on each other. The pillars of the theory of Structuralism include:
• Writers and critics of realism consider that the role of the author should be to depict reality as it appears in the respective society. • Any literary work has a structure that is self-sufficient in its various interconnected parts, which come together to form a single complete system (plot). • Realists believed that a writer was required to provide a complete picture of their society as it truly is, without exaggerating or diminishing it. • Structuralists explain that particular functions of literature should be considered, for example, the use of language targeting the individual and that depend on the rules of the literary language system and language in general. Therefore, the first principle of Structuralism helped us identify how settings contribute to bringing out key elements of the plot as well as the traits of various characters in the selected novels analyzed. UTANGULIZI  
Kazi ya fasihi hutengenezwa kwa kutumia vipengele mbalimbali vya kisanaa, vikiwemo matumizi ya mpangilio. Kipengele hiki ni muhimu katika uandishi wa fasihi na huchangia katika ujenzi na utoaji wa ujumbe wa mwandishi. Mpangilio mara nyingi hutumiwa na mwandishi kufikisha ujumbe wao kwa msomaji. Kipengele cha kuweka kimefafanuliwa na wanazuoni mbalimbali. Kwa mfano, Wamitila (2008) anafasili mpangilio kuwa ni kipengele kinachomdhihirishia msomaji mahali na lini matukio au matukio fulani yalitendeka. Mipangilio inaweza kuwa ya kweli au ya kufikiria. Mipangilio halisi inahusu maeneo ambayo yapo katika ulimwengu halisi. Kwa mfano, mazingira kama vile msitu, chuo kikuu, nyumbani, ofisini, jijini, na mahali pa ibada. Mipangilio ya kufikiria inarejelea mazingira yasiyo ya kawaida na mengi hukutana nayo kupitia ndoto. Mifano ya mazingira ya kufikirika ni pamoja na paradiso, ulimwengu wa chini, na kuzimu. Mipangilio inayoonyeshwa kwa msomaji inabaki akilini mwao. Waandishi wengi wanapotunga kazi zao huziweka katika mazingira tofauti ili kukidhi dhamira mbalimbali za kifasihi na kisanaa. Kwa hivyo ni sahihi kusema kwamba mpangilio ni nguzo ya kimsingi katika tungo za kisanaa. Mipangilio huathiri mtazamo wa msomaji kwa njia nyingi, ikiwa ni pamoja na kutoa taswira mbalimbali za kile ambacho mwandishi alikusudia kuwasilisha (Wamitila, 2003; Matei, 2012; Massoud, 2022). Taswira hizi zaweza kuwa, kwa mfano: taswira ya kuona, ambayo humpa msomaji uwezo wa 'kuona' kile ambacho mwandishi anaonyesha kupitia maneno; taswira ya harakati, ambayo humsaidia msomaji kupata tukio 'katika mwendo' kulingana na mazingira ambayo tukio hufanyika; taswira ya hisi, ambapo msomaji hupata hisia mbalimbali za wahusika ndani ya muktadha wakati mwandishi anapochunguza hisia hizo; taswira ya kustaajabisha, ambayo msomaji huona katika mazingira ambapo vitendo huibua majibu ya kutema mate; na nyingine nyingi kama vile taswira ya sauti. Tukichukulia mfano wa eneo la Selea, linalojitokeza katika riwaya ya *Kiu*, mwandishi anatueleza kuwa lilikuwa ni mahali (sehemu) yenye sifa ya umaskini uliokithiri na dhiki nyingi; wakazi waliishi kwenye vibanda na wengine kwenye vyumba vilivyoezekwa kwa udongo, na barabara ya kufika huko ilikuwa mbovu kiasi kwamba hata gari la Mwinyi halikuweza kufika. Wahusika kama vile Bahati na mama yake Chausiku, walioishi katika mtaa huu, pia walikuwa maskini. Hii ina maana kwamba mazingira yalikuwa na athari ya moja kwa moja kwa wahusika hawa na sifa zao. Walikuwa maskini, ndiyo maana waliishi huko. Wamitila (2002) anaeleza kuwa mazingira humfahamisha msomaji kuhusu safari ya mhusika tangu mwanzo hadi mwisho katika hadithi. Kwa hivyo, msomaji anakuja kuelewa tabia katika kila eneo na katika kila hatua ya ukuaji wao. Mfano mzuri ni mhusika Mwalimu Majisfu katika riwaya ya *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*, ambaye tunasimuliwa maisha yake ya utotoni, masomo yake nje ya nchi, kujihusisha na ulevi na kushindwa kuhudhuria masomo yake katika shule ya Nasaba Bora, kufukuzwa kazi na kutafuta kazi nyingine, kujihusisha na wizi wa miswada ya waandishi, na kushindwa kutoa mihadhara pale alipoalikwa Wangwani. Hapa, tunapewa sifa kadhaa za mhusika huyu kupitia mazingira mbalimbali—kwamba alikuwa na elimu, mlevi, mwizi wa masomo, na mzembe katika kazi yake. Sifa za wahusika mara nyingi husaidia kutambua na kutofautisha mhusika fulani kwa urahisi. Sifa hizi mara nyingi hufichua tabia, tabia, au hata utu wao ndani ya kazi fulani ya fasihi. Katika suala hili, mpangilio una jukumu kubwa katika kusawiri sifa za wahusika (Wamitila, 2002). Kwa kiasi kikubwa, wahusika huathiriwa na mipangilio ambayo wameonyeshwa. Baadhi ya kazi za fasihi zinaonyesha mazingira ya umaskini, shida nyingi, na wahusika wanaoishi katika vibanda na vyumba vilivyopakwa matope, pamoja na usafiri unaotegemea barabara mbovu. Hii ina maana kwamba mipangilio iliyosawiriwa na msanii ina athari ya moja kwa moja katika ujenzi wa sifa za wahusika katika kazi husika. Hili ndilo suala ambalo lilichunguzwa katika utafiti uliotoa makala haya. Lengo kuu lilikuwa ni kuchunguza usawiri wa uwekaji katika riwaya za *Kiu* na *Kidagaa Kimemwozea* ili kubainisha uhusiano uliopo kati ya sifa za mpangilio na wahusika. Kupitia tathmini, hoja inayoibuliwa na makala haya ni kwamba mazingira ambayo wahusika hujipata katika riwaya ya *Kiu* na *Kidagaa Kimemwozea* yanachangia katika ujenzi wa sifa zao. Imethibitishwa kuwa mpangilio pia huathiri jinsi wahusika fulani wanavyosawiriwa. Mipangilio ina jukumu kubwa katika kuwajalia wahusika sifa fulani (Wamitila, 2002). Kwa kiasi fulani, mahali na wakati ambapo mhusika hujikuta anaashiria na huathiri taswira ya sifa zao. Kwa hivyo, makala haya yanachunguza uhusiano kati ya mpangilio na sifa za wahusika katika kazi hizi mbili na kudhihirisha wazi uwepo wa uhusiano huu na vile vile waandishi hawa wamewasawiri wahusika wao.

MTINDO WA KUANDIKA
Wamitila (2002) anaeleza kuwa mpangilio huchangia pakubwa katika usawiri wa sifa za wahusika. Anaeleza kuwa wahusika huathiriwa kwa kiasi kikubwa na mazingira yao. Madai haya ya Wamitila yalijitokeza katika utafiti huu. Ili kusawiri mhusika kwa namna fulani, ni muhimu kuchunguza mazingira ambamo wanapatikana (Wamitila, 2008). MISINGI YA NADHARIA  
Kupitia nguzo ya pili ya nadharia ya Uhalisia, utafiti huu ulichunguza jinsi watunzi wa vitabu hivi teule walivyosawiri uhalisia katika kazi zao kupitia mazingira mbalimbali waliyoyatumia. Hili lilituwezesha kubainisha baadhi ya sifa za wahusika mbalimbali na hivyo kutusaidia kutimiza lengo la utafiti huu, ambalo ni kutathmini mchango wa kuweka katika kujenga sifa za wahusika katika riwaya za *Kiu* na *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*. Malengo ya utafiti yaliongozwa na muunganiko wa nadharia mbili, nazo ni nadharia ya Uhalisia na nadharia ya Umuundo. Nadharia ya Uhalisia iliibuka katika karne ya kumi na tisa (Ntarangwi, 2004). Neno 'uhalisia' ni tafsiri ya neno la Kiingereza 'realism', ambalo awali lilitumiwa kurejelea tawi la falsafa linalohusika na mambo yanayohusiana na mtazamo wa mwanadamu. Hivi sasa, neno hili linatumika kurejelea maana mbili: ya kwanza ni ile inayotathmini hali ya maisha, yaani, uhalisia katika fasihi unaoashiria ustadi wa utunzi na kueleza matukio kulingana na usawaziko; na maana ya pili ni hali halisi ya maisha ya mwanadamu. Nadharia ya Umuundo mara nyingi huhusishwa na wanaisimu wa Prague (Mwangi, 2005). Husisitiza vipengele vya kazi ya kisanaa kama vile ploti, ujumbe, wahusika, muktadha, lugha, na jinsi haya yanavyoingiliana ili kukamilisha kazi inayohusika. Nadharia hii inachunguza uhusiano kati ya vipengele mbalimbali vya utunzi wa fasihi, kama vile uchanganuzi wa masimulizi ya kimuundo. Nadharia inazingatia usimulizi wa kazi ya kisanaa. Kwa mfano, uchanganuzi wa kimuundo wa riwaya huichukulia riwaya kama kazi inayojitosheleza yenye vipengele vya kimuundo kama vile ploti, wahusika, na mbinu mbalimbali za usimulizi zinazofungamana na kutegemeana. MBINU ZA UTAFITI  
Data za utafiti wa utafiti huu zilichanganuliwa kwa kuzingatia maudhui ili kubainisha aina mbalimbali za mazingira katika riwaya teule na michango yake katika ukuzaji wa sifa za wahusika mbalimbali katika riwaya hizi. Kufuatia uchanganuzi wa data, matokeo ya utafiti yamewasilishwa kwa njia ya ufafanuzi. Uchambuzi wenyewe ulifanywa kwa mujibu wa malengo na mifumo ya kinadharia iliyoongoza uchunguzi. Ufafanuzi ni mbinu ya uchanganuzi inayomwezesha mtafiti kusoma au kusikiliza kazi ya fasihi, kuelewa dhamira zake, mitazamo ya kifalsafa ya kazi husika, miongoni mwa vipengele vingine muhimu (Adam, 2014). JINSI KUWEKA MAUMBO SIFA ZA WAHUSIKA KATIKA RIWAYA HALISI  
Mipangilio ina jukumu kubwa katika kuunda sifa fulani katika wahusika (Wamitila, 2002). Kwa kiasi fulani, mahali na wakati ambapo mhusika hujikuta anaashiria na kuathiri taswira ya sifa zao. Utafiti huu wa tathmini ulijikita katika muundo wa utafiti wa uchanganuzi. Utafiti wa uchanganuzi huchunguza viambishi kwa kina ili kufikia hitimisho mwafaka (Soma, 1987). Mfumo huu ulituwezesha kukusanya, kuchambua na kueleza matokeo kwa mujibu wa matokeo ya utafiti huu, hivyo kutusaidia kufikia hitimisho mwafaka. Mbili kati ya idadi iliyolengwa ya riwaya 10 za uhalisia zilichaguliwa kimakusudi. Huu ni usampulishaji madhubuti, ambapo sampuli huchaguliwa kwa misingi ya kuwa na sifa za kipekee zinazohitajika katika utafiti. Sampuli za kimakusudi mara nyingi huhusisha uteuzi wa kundi wakilishi la masomo, vitu, au dhana zinazowiana na viambajengo vinavyochunguzwa (Kombo & Tromp, 2006). Kwa hivyo, riwaya teule zililingana na malengo na mifumo ya kinadharia ya utafiti, na ndiyo maana zilichaguliwa kimakusudi kwa madhumuni hayo. Sifa za wahusika mara nyingi husaidia kutambua na kutofautisha mhusika fulani kwa urahisi zaidi; sifa hizi mara nyingi huonyesha mielekeo, tabia, au hata mwelekeo wa mhusika ndani ya kazi husika ya fasihi. Kwa mfano, katika *Kiu*, mazingira ya nyumbani kwa Mzee Mwinyi yamesawiriwa kwa namna ambayo chumba chake kilikuwa na kapeti na pambo la thamani. Isitoshe, alikuwa na gari aina ya Mercedes Benz, jambo ambalo linaonyesha kuwa alikuwa na mali nyingi na hivyo alikuwa tajiri. Vifungu vifuatavyo vimetumika kuchanganua na kujadili kila riwaya kivyake, kwa kuanzia na ujenzi wa sifa za wahusika katika *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*. discourses.source_txt: Setting is defined as the time and place in which events, incidents, or actions occur in a given literary work. Settings can be real or imagined.
discourses.translated_txt: Mazingira hufafanuliwa kama wakati na mahali ambapo matukio, matukio, au vitendo hutokea katika kazi fulani ya fasihi. Mipangilio inaweza kuwa halisi au ya kufikiria.

discourses.source_txt: The study that informed this article aimed to examine the depiction of setting in Mohamed S. Mohamed's novel *Kiu* and Ken Walibora's novel *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*. Although the research had three specific objectives, this article focuses on just one objective—to assess the contribution of setting to the construction of character traits in the novels *Kiu* and *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*.
discourses.translated_txt: Utafiti uliofahamisha makala haya ulilenga kuchunguza usawiri wa mazingira katika riwaya ya *Kiu* ya Mohamed S. Mohamed na ya *Kidagaa Kimemwozea* ya Ken Walibora. Ingawa utafiti ulikuwa na malengo mahususi matatu, makala haya yamejikita katika dhamira moja tu—kutathmini mchango wa kuweka katika ujenzi wa sifa za wahusika katika riwaya za *Kiu* na *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*.

discourses.source_txt: The assessment itself is grounded in a combination of two theories—Realism and Structuralism. The theory of Realism examines the authenticity of the social setting, while Structuralism emphasizes the function and interrelationship of artistic elements.
discourses.translated_txt: Tathmini yenyewe imejikita katika mchanganyiko wa nadharia mbili—Uhalisia na Umuundo. Nadharia ya Uhalisia huchunguza uhalisi wa mazingira ya kijamii, huku Umuundo unasisitiza dhima na uhusiano wa vipengele vya kisanaa.

discourses.source_txt: This evaluative study was conducted in the library, employing an analytical design. The research area is written literature, specifically the genre of the Swahili novel. The target population of the study comprises 10 realist novels that depict authentic settings.
discourses.translated_txt: Utafiti huu wa tathmini ulifanywa maktabani kwa kutumia muundo wa uchanganuzi. Eneo la utafiti ni fasihi andishi, hasa utanzu wa riwaya ya Kiswahili. Idadi inayolengwa ya utafiti inajumuisha riwaya 10 za uhalisia zinazosawiri mipangilio halisi.

discourses.source_txt: A sample of two novels, *Kiu* and *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*, was selected through purposive sampling.
discourses.translated_txt: Sampuli ya riwaya mbili, *Kiu* na *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*, iliteuliwa kupitia sampuli madhubuti.

discourses.source_txt: These novels were selected based on the abundance of the aspects under investigation, namely the depiction of setting. In addition to reflecting the objectives of the study, the composition of the selected novels aligns with the framework of the combined theoretical approaches. The primary data for the study was collected through intensive reading of the texts of the selected novels.
discourses.translated_txt: Riwaya hizi ziliteuliwa kwa kuzingatia wingi wa vipengele vinavyochunguzwa, yaani usawiri wa mpangilio. Pamoja na kuakisi malengo ya utafiti, utunzi wa riwaya teule unawiana na kiunzi cha mikabala ya kinadharia. Data za msingi za utafiti zilikusanywa kwa usomaji wa kina wa matini za riwaya teule.

discourses.source_txt: Secondary data was collected through intensive reading of books, theses, and various academic articles. The collected data was categorized according to the theoretical frameworks and objectives of the study.
discourses.translated_txt: Data ya upili ilikusanywa kupitia usomaji wa kina wa vitabu, nadharia na makala mbalimbali za kitaaluma. Data iliyokusanywa iliainishwa kulingana na mifumo ya kinadharia na malengo ya utafiti.

discourses.source_txt: They were analyzed according to their content and the results presented descriptively. The findings of the study indicate that settings have a direct contribution to the development of characters' traits.
discourses.translated_txt: Zilichambuliwa kulingana na maudhui yao na matokeo yakawasilishwa kwa maelezo. Matokeo ya utafiti yanaonyesha kuwa mipangilio ina mchango wa moja kwa moja katika ukuzaji wa sifa za wahusika.

discourses.source_txt: These settings include: spatial settings (such as the banks of the Kiberenge River, the room of Chief Nasaba Bora, the forest, the cell, Mzee Mwinyi's room, and neighborhoods such as Vibyongoni, Selea, Ukele, and others) and temporal settings (the colonial era, five-year periods, the Second World War, and so on).
discourses.translated_txt: Mipangilio hii ni pamoja na: mazingira ya anga (kama vile kingo za Mto Kiberenge, chumba cha Chifu Nasaba Bora, msitu, selo, chumba cha Mzee Mwinyi, na vitongoji kama Vibyongoni, Selea, Ukele, na vingine) na mazingira ya muda (zama za ukoloni, vipindi vya miaka mitano, Vita Kuu ya Pili ya Dunia, na kadhalika).

discourses.source_txt: These settings were skillfully crafted in a way that greatly facilitated the development of the characters' traits.
discourses.translated_txt: Mipangilio hii iliundwa kwa ustadi kwa njia ambayo iliwezesha sana ukuzaji wa sifa za wahusika.

discourses.source_txt: The findings of this study are beneficial to novelists and literary critics in general. They will help them craft stories that portray and reflect authentic settings. Furthermore, literary critics will be enabled to identify and evaluate various settings along with their roles in literary works.
discourses.translated_txt: Matokeo ya utafiti huu yana manufaa kwa waandishi wa riwaya na wahakiki wa fasihi kwa ujumla. Watawasaidia kutengeneza hadithi zinazoonyesha na kuonyesha mipangilio halisi. Zaidi ya hayo, wahakiki wa fasihi watawezeshwa kubainisha na kutathmini mazingira mbalimbali pamoja na dhima zao katika kazi za fasihi.

discourses.source_txt:
INTRODUCTION  
A literary work is constructed using various artistic elements, including the use of setting. This element is important in literary writing and contributes to the construction and delivery of the author's message. Setting is often used by a writer to convey their message to the reader. The element of setting has been defined by various scholars.
discourses.translated_txt:
UTANGULIZI  
Kazi ya fasihi hutengenezwa kwa kutumia vipengele mbalimbali vya kisanaa, vikiwemo matumizi ya mpangilio. Kipengele hiki ni muhimu katika uandishi wa fasihi na huchangia katika ujenzi na utoaji wa ujumbe wa mwandishi. Mpangilio mara nyingi hutumiwa na mwandishi kufikisha ujumbe wao kwa msomaji. Kipengele cha kuweka kimefafanuliwa na wanazuoni mbalimbali.

discourses.source_txt: For example, Wamitila (2008) defines setting as an element that reveals to the reader where and when certain incidents or events took place. Settings can be realistic or imaginary. Realistic settings pertain to locations that exist in the real world. For instance, settings such as a forest, at the university, at home, in the office, in the city, and in places of worship. Imaginary settings refer to unusual environments and many are encountered through dreams. Examples of imaginary settings include paradise, the underworld, and hell.
discourses.translated_txt: Kwa mfano, Wamitila (2008) anafasili mpangilio kuwa ni kipengele kinachomdhihirishia msomaji mahali na lini matukio au matukio fulani yalitendeka. Mipangilio inaweza kuwa ya kweli au ya kufikiria. Mipangilio halisi inahusu maeneo ambayo yapo katika ulimwengu halisi. Kwa mfano, mazingira kama vile msitu, chuo kikuu, nyumbani, ofisini, jijini, na mahali pa ibada. Mipangilio ya kufikiria inarejelea mazingira yasiyo ya kawaida na mengi hukutana nayo kupitia ndoto. Mifano ya mazingira ya kufikirika ni pamoja na paradiso, ulimwengu wa chini, na kuzimu.

discourses.source_txt: The setting depicted for the reader remains in their mind. Many writers, when crafting their works, place them in different settings to satisfy various literary and artistic purposes. It is therefore valid to state that setting is a fundamental pillar in artistic compositions.
discourses.translated_txt: Mipangilio inayoonyeshwa kwa msomaji inabaki akilini mwao. Waandishi wengi wanapotunga kazi zao huziweka katika mazingira tofauti ili kukidhi dhamira mbalimbali za kifasihi na kisanaa. Kwa hivyo ni sahihi kusema kwamba mpangilio ni nguzo ya kimsingi katika tungo za kisanaa.

discourses.source_txt: Setting influences the reader's perception in many ways, including providing a variety of images of what the author intended to convey (Wamitila, 2003; Matei, 2012; Massoud, 2022). These images can be, for example: visual imagery, which gives the reader the ability to 'see' what the author illustrates through words; movement imagery, which helps the reader experience an event 'in motion' according to the setting in which the event takes place; sensory imagery, where the reader experiences various feelings of the characters within the context as the author explores those emotions; gustatory imagery, which the reader perceives in settings where actions evoke a salivating response; and many others such as auditory imagery.
discourses.translated_txt: Mipangilio huathiri mtazamo wa msomaji kwa njia nyingi, ikiwa ni pamoja na kutoa taswira mbalimbali za kile ambacho mwandishi alikusudia kuwasilisha (Wamitila, 2003; Matei, 2012; Massoud, 2022). Taswira hizi zaweza kuwa, kwa mfano: taswira ya kuona, ambayo humpa msomaji uwezo wa 'kuona' kile ambacho mwandishi anaonyesha kupitia maneno; taswira ya harakati, ambayo humsaidia msomaji kupata tukio 'katika mwendo' kulingana na mazingira ambayo tukio hufanyika; taswira ya hisi, ambapo msomaji hupata hisia mbalimbali za wahusika ndani ya muktadha wakati mwandishi anapochunguza hisia hizo; taswira ya kustaajabisha, ambayo msomaji huona katika mazingira ambapo vitendo huibua majibu ya kutema mate; na nyingine nyingi kama vile taswira ya sauti.

discourses.source_txt: Taking the example of the area of Selea, which appears in the novel *Kiu*, the author tells us that it was a place (setting) characterized by pervasive poverty and numerous hardships; the residents lived in shacks and some in rooms plastered with mud, and the road to get there was so bad that even Mwinyi’s car could not reach it.
discourses.translated_txt: Tukichukulia mfano wa eneo la Selea, linalojitokeza katika riwaya ya *Kiu*, mwandishi anatueleza kuwa lilikuwa ni mahali (sehemu) yenye sifa ya umaskini uliokithiri na dhiki nyingi; wakazi waliishi kwenye vibanda na wengine kwenye vyumba vilivyoezekwa kwa udongo, na barabara ya kufika huko ilikuwa mbovu kiasi kwamba hata gari la Mwinyi halikuweza kufika.

discourses.source_txt: Characters such as Bahati and Chausiku’s mother, who lived in this neighborhood, were also poor. This means that the environment had a direct impact on these characters and their traits. They were poor, which is why they lived there.
discourses.translated_txt: Wahusika kama vile Bahati na mama yake Chausiku, walioishi katika mtaa huu, pia walikuwa maskini. Hii ina maana kwamba mazingira yalikuwa na athari ya moja kwa moja kwa wahusika hawa na sifa zao. Walikuwa maskini, ndiyo maana waliishi huko.

discourses.source_txt: Wamitila (2002) explains that setting informs the reader about the character's journey from beginning to end in the story. Therefore, the reader comes to understand the character in every location and at every stage of their development.
discourses.translated_txt: Wamitila (2002) anaeleza kuwa mazingira humfahamisha msomaji kuhusu safari ya mhusika tangu mwanzo hadi mwisho katika hadithi. Kwa hivyo, msomaji anakuja kuelewa tabia katika kila eneo na katika kila hatua ya ukuaji wao.

discourses.source_txt: A good example is the character Mwalimu Majisfu in the novel *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*, about whom we are told of his childhood, his studies abroad, his involvement in alcoholism and failure to attend his classes at Nasaba Bora school, being dismissed from work and finding another job, becoming involved in theft of authors’ manuscripts, and failing to deliver lectures when invited to Wangwani. Here, we are given several traits of this character through various settings—that he was educated, an alcoholic, an academic thief, and negligent in his work.
discourses.translated_txt: Mfano mzuri ni mhusika Mwalimu Majisfu katika riwaya ya *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*, ambaye tunasimuliwa maisha yake ya utotoni, masomo yake nje ya nchi, kujihusisha na ulevi na kushindwa kuhudhuria masomo yake katika shule ya Nasaba Bora, kufukuzwa kazi na kutafuta kazi nyingine, kujihusisha na wizi wa miswada ya waandishi, na kushindwa kutoa mihadhara pale alipoalikwa Wangwani. Hapa, tunapewa sifa kadhaa za mhusika huyu kupitia mazingira mbalimbali—kwamba alikuwa na elimu, mlevi, mwizi wa masomo, na mzembe katika kazi yake.

discourses.source_txt: Character traits often help to identify and distinguish a particular character easily. These traits frequently reveal their habits, behavior, or even personality within the given literary work.
discourses.translated_txt: Sifa za wahusika mara nyingi husaidia kutambua na kutofautisha mhusika fulani kwa urahisi. Sifa hizi mara nyingi hufichua tabia, tabia, au hata utu wao ndani ya kazi fulani ya fasihi.

discourses.source_txt: In this regard, setting plays a significant role in depicting character traits (Wamitila, 2002). To a large extent, characters are influenced by the settings in which they are portrayed. Some literary works depict settings of poverty, numerous hardships, and characters living in shacks and mud-plastered rooms, as well as transportation that relies on poor roads. This means that the settings depicted by the artist have a direct impact on the construction of the traits of the characters in the given work.
discourses.translated_txt: Katika suala hili, mpangilio una jukumu kubwa katika kusawiri sifa za wahusika (Wamitila, 2002). Kwa kiasi kikubwa, wahusika huathiriwa na mipangilio ambayo wameonyeshwa. Baadhi ya kazi za fasihi zinaonyesha mazingira ya umaskini, shida nyingi, na wahusika wanaoishi katika vibanda na vyumba vilivyopakwa matope, pamoja na usafiri unaotegemea barabara mbovu. Hii ina maana kwamba mipangilio iliyosawiriwa na msanii ina athari ya moja kwa moja katika ujenzi wa sifa za wahusika katika kazi husika.

discourses.source_txt:
This is the issue that was investigated in the research that produced this article. The main objective was to examine the depiction of setting in the novels *Kiu* and *Kidagaa Kimemwozea* in order to establish the relationship between setting and character traits. Through assessment, the argument advanced by this article is that the settings in which characters find themselves in the novels *Kiu* and *Kidagaa Kimemwozea* contribute to the construction of their traits. It has been established that setting also influences the way certain characters are depicted. Setting plays a significant role in endowing characters with particular traits (Wamitila, 2002). To a certain extent, the place and time in which a character finds themselves signals and affects the depiction of their traits. Therefore, this article explores the relationship between setting and character traits in these two works and clearly reveals the existence of this relationship as well as how these authors have portrayed their characters.

WRITING STYLE
Wamitila (2002) states that setting makes substantial contributions to the depiction of character traits. He explains that characters are largely influenced by their surroundings. This assertion by Wamitila emerged in this research. In order to depict a character in a particular way, it is essential to examine the setting in which they are found (Wamitila, 2008).
discourses.translated_txt:
Hili ndilo suala ambalo lilichunguzwa katika utafiti uliotoa makala haya. Lengo kuu lilikuwa ni kuchunguza usawiri wa uwekaji katika riwaya za *Kiu* na *Kidagaa Kimemwozea* ili kubainisha uhusiano uliopo kati ya sifa za mpangilio na wahusika. Kupitia tathmini, hoja inayoibuliwa na makala haya ni kwamba mazingira ambayo wahusika hujipata katika riwaya ya *Kiu* na *Kidagaa Kimemwozea* yanachangia katika ujenzi wa sifa zao. Imethibitishwa kuwa mpangilio pia huathiri jinsi wahusika fulani wanavyosawiriwa. Mipangilio ina jukumu kubwa katika kuwajalia wahusika sifa fulani (Wamitila, 2002). Kwa kiasi fulani, mahali na wakati ambapo mhusika hujikuta anaashiria na huathiri taswira ya sifa zao. Kwa hivyo, makala haya yanachunguza uhusiano kati ya mpangilio na sifa za wahusika katika kazi hizi mbili na kudhihirisha wazi uwepo wa uhusiano huu na vile vile waandishi hawa wamewasawiri wahusika wao.

MTINDO WA KUANDIKA
Wamitila (2002) anaeleza kuwa mpangilio huchangia pakubwa katika usawiri wa sifa za wahusika. Anaeleza kuwa wahusika huathiriwa kwa kiasi kikubwa na mazingira yao. Madai haya ya Wamitila yalijitokeza katika utafiti huu. Ili kusawiri mhusika kwa namna fulani, ni muhimu kuchunguza mazingira ambamo wanapatikana (Wamitila, 2008).

discourses.source_txt: This claim was affirmed by this research when the character Majununi was examined in the novel *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*. We found that this character was used by the author to inform us about a specific historical period, which is the Second World War, and that Majununi was among the British soldiers who fought in this war. Many people died on the battlefield, but he survived.
discourses.translated_txt: Dai hili lilithibitishwa na utafiti huu mhusika Majununi alipotahiniwa katika riwaya ya *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*. Tuligundua kuwa mhusika huyu alitumiwa na mwandishi kutufahamisha kuhusu kipindi maalum cha kihistoria, ambacho ni Vita vya Pili vya Dunia, na kwamba Majununi alikuwa miongoni mwa askari wa Uingereza waliopigana vita hivi. Watu wengi walikufa kwenye uwanja wa vita, lakini alinusurika.

discourses.source_txt: • Realists recognized the role of the writer who adheres to realism by selecting, analyzing, and differentiating the subjects they wish to address in order to portray reality as it truly exists in society. Therefore, when we examine some of these scholars' definitions, we find that they focused on the setting of place and time in their explanations. These definitions made a significant contribution to this study because the research itself examined setting based on the notion that setting is the time and place where artistic events occur.

Kwa hivyo, tunapozichunguza baadhi ya fasili za wanavyuoni hao, tunagundua kuwa zilizingatia mpangilio wa mahali na wakati katika maelezo yao. Fasili hizi zilitoa mchango mkubwa katika utafiti huu kwa sababu utafiti wenyewe ulichunguza mpangilio kwa kuzingatia dhana kwamba mpangilio ni wakati na mahali ambapo matukio ya kisanaa hutokea.

discourses.source_txt:
THEORETICAL FOUNDATIONS  
Through the second pillar of the theory of Realism, this study examined how the authors of these selected books depicted reality in their works through the various settings they employed. This allowed us to identify some of the traits of different characters and thus helped us fulfill the objective of this study, which is to assess the contribution of setting in constructing character traits in the novels *Kiu* and *Kidagaa Kimemwozea*.
discourses.translated_txt:
MISINGI YA NADHARIA  
Kupitia nguzo ya pili ya nadharia ya Uhalisia, utafiti huu ulichunguza jinsi watunzi wa vitabu hivi teule walivyosawiri uhalisia katika kazi zao kupitia mazingira mbalimbali waliyoyatumia.
